'''Golden Fury''', also known as '''Toborro's Glittering Fury Mark II''', was a [[isotope-5 droid]] built by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and powered by the rare substance called [[Isotope-5]]. Repurposed by renegade [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] left on the surface of [[Makeb]] after the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the giant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was left to defend its new master's large cache of isotope-5 in its former master's [[Toborro's Palace|courtyard]]. Similar to its sister-model [[Toborro's Glittering Fury]], it was able to fire a deadly stream of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] light at a distance and release a destructive cloud of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] for anyone who chose to engage it closely. Despite the immense firepower it was able to discharge, it was defeated and destroyed after [[Toborro]]'s death.
